answer: Because the timing is recorded against the knoll challenge, the nebula audit can replay the nadir history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 162 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 4576 identities would post 1330 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
